accepted_gaps.title: No common end-to-end service metric
accepted_gaps.rationale: Existing reports expose partial metrics but not one retrieval contract spanning integrity, access, condition, latency, and cost.

accepted_gaps.title: Coding is weakly coupled to storage condition
accepted_gaps.rationale: Physical aging and repeated retrieval alter the error channel that coding must tolerate.

accepted_gaps.title: Random access is not evaluated as an operational service
accepted_gaps.rationale: Selective recovery needs explicit crosstalk, coverage, index, and repeat-access accounting.

accepted_gaps.title: Future decoding lacks portable recovery metadata
accepted_gaps.rationale: Future users need an unambiguous encoding, constraint, checksum, and decoder manifest.

accepted_gaps.title: Theoretical density is disconnected from usable density
accepted_gaps.rationale: Addressing, redundancy, constraints, packaging, and retained metadata change both density and cost.

triage.rejected_gap: DNA cannot store arbitrary digital information
